response.method: Fixed-rule single-step graph propagation on synthetic calibration observations
response.formula: C=corr(R_train); A_ij=abs(C_ij) if i!=j and abs(C_ij)>=0.25 else 0; P=row_normalize(A+I); s=mean(R_train)/sample_std(R_train)*sqrt(252); z=0.5*s+0.5*P@s; q=softmax((z-penalty*vol/mean(vol))/temperature); w=(1-concentration)/6+concentration*q

metric_definitions.cumulative_return: prod(1 + held-out daily portfolio return) - 1; decimal fraction
metric_definitions.annualized_volatility: sample_std(held-out daily portfolio returns) * sqrt(252); decimal fraction
metric_definitions.sharpe_ratio: mean(held-out daily portfolio returns) / sample_std * sqrt(252); risk-free rate 0; 0 when standard deviation is 0
metric_definitions.max_drawdown: max(1 - equity / running_max(equity)); nonnegative decimal fraction; includes initial equity 1
metric_definitions.graph_node_training_volatility: sample daily standard deviation over calibration days 0..119; decimal fraction
metric_definitions.graph_node_training_signal: calibration mean / sample daily standard deviation * sqrt(252)

limitations: Fictional data only; no real securities or investment advice.
No original Factor GCN code, weights, research data, or original results are integrated.
Fixed-rule graph propagation is not a trained GCN; no learned model artifact exists.
Risk labels change fixed formula parameters; realized volatility order is not guaranteed.
Only 60 held-out synthetic days; annualization is illustrative and is not a forecast.
Constant target weights are applied each day (implicit daily weight reset); trading/rebalancing execution, turnover, fees, and costs are not modeled.
Repeatability assumes the same source and dependency versions; cross-platform bitwise identity is not promised.
